notes:
New Date filter: pick a day, a month or a year, the same day every year (“On this day”), or a range. Clicking a folder in the sidebar no longer secretly filters the map, and each filter in the green bar has its own ✕. Rename folders inside Photon, and search finds photos by their parent folder names. Tidier location picking. Folders moved or renamed outside Photon keep their stars, captions and albums. The lightbox filmstrip no longer shifts near the ends, and background work gives way while you browse.
Photon has a new home: downloads now come from photon.ventureindustries.au.
